adjudication.depicted_input: Paired H&E imaging patches and spatial sequencing inputs for the H2O training/fine-tuning architecture, including patch extraction/checkerboard sampling, Image FM and ST FM alignment, contrastive learning, and ST prediction.
adjudication.rationale: The current crop is defensible for the listed fine_tuning route. It visibly shows the route-specific input objects and immediate training interface: H&E imaging, spatial sequencing, sampled patch/grid representations, Image FM/ST FM pathways, contrastive alignment, and decoder-side ST prediction. Under the atlas rules, the exact variant name 'H2O-PRAD' does not need to appear when the paper uses the same depicted H2O input mechanism for named downstream fine-tuned variants, and training/fine-tuning inputs are in scope.
